newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: SEOUL STOCKS SEEN RISING, SELLING PRESSURE AT 750.
newsitem.headline: SEOUL STOCKS SEEN RISING, SELLING PRESSURE AT 750.

text.p: Seoul stocks are expected to rise for the fourth straight day on Thursday, but the gain would be limited with selling pressure arising at 750 points, brokers said.
"Investors betting the market would turn bullish in the near future would lead the rise," said Chung Chang-shik of Dongsuh Securities.
"However, selling would increase as the index nears 750."
The composite stock index closed Wednesday up 4.79 points to 745.65.
Brokers said shares of Korean Air Lines and its affiliates, which have fallen sharply on Wednesday on crash news in Guam, would see their losses easing.
Brokers said any developments to the struggling Kia Group would be closely watched.
